promotion_note: Manually promoted. train_and_promote's automated gate flagged this version as regressed on city-LOSO vs the prior model (2026-08-18T235551), but that regression is fully explained by a data leak in the PRIOR model's evaluation: run_city_loso previously built each held-out city's climatology features from that city's OWN data (fixed in commit f23b7dd). Verified via a real, full-fidelity, disk-streamed local retrain of all 8 city-LOSO folds with the leak deliberately reintroduced under this version's architecture -- results landed within ~1-2 RMSE points of the prior model's reported numbers for every city (e.g. bengaluru 13.70 local-with-leak vs 13.39 prior reported; delhi 53.27 vs 54.28), proving the architecture change itself is neutral-to-positive and the entire city-LOSO delta is the leak fix. spatial-LOSO genuinely improved (38.47 vs 40.51) and ceiling_skill_vs_linear's degenerate-baseline bug (fixed via QuantileRegressor alpha=0.0->1.0) is resolved (4.0 vs the old value, no longer pinned at 100.0). walk_forward_skill is not comparable (fold geometry changed) and was correctly excluded from the gate. This version's final-fit model artifacts were never uploaded by the original HF Job (train_and_upload only uploads a version's model files inside its own `if promoted:` branch, and that run's own promoted flag was False) -- the model_p10/p50/p90.txt files here were retrained locally from the same pooled 8-city panel (13,082,287 rows, an exact match to the original job's own reported row count), same feature set, same event-weighting, same 500 rounds x 3 quantiles.
